knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Appendix B: hydrotherapy water is capped at 38 degrees Celsius, and 28 to 35 degrees is the aim.
Appendix B and table 2: free chlorine of at least 2.0 mg/L is the floor for hydrotherapy water.
Appendix B lists unstable heart conditions, active infections and open wounds as reasons to refuse hydrotherapy.
The stabilisers and microbial growth section says stabilisers are barred from indoor hydrotherapy water.

practicalCriteria: On a supplied hydrotherapy pool, reads water and air conditions and states whether each is within the standard's limits.
Compares a supplied disinfectant reading with the minimum and the recommended heavy-use level, and escalates the shortfall.
Applies an exclusion from a supplied scenario and records it.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Hydrotherapy daily record for the assessed pool
Exclusion record in a supplied scenario
stopWorkCriteria: Water above 38 degrees: keep the pool closed to users and escalate.
Free chlorine below 2.0 mg/L: keep the pool closed until corrected and retested.
User with an open wound or acute infection: refuse entry and record it.
